Topic 7.1: The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.)
2. Practise The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.)

1. Explain the main ideas in The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.)

   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) in the examples.
2. Explain The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Rightly Guided Caliphs • Abubakar (R.A.) • Umar (R.A.) • Uthman (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
